name: European long distance path E6 - Main route Austria
description_md:
This waymarked hiking route is known as the European long distance path E6, Main route Austria. The trail spans a distance of 596.3 km across Austria within the international waymarked hiking network.

Walkers face a hard difficulty rating based on distance and ascent, featuring 24454 m of ascent and 24933 m of descent. The route is signposted as E6 and requires about 215 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes Melk within 100 m, Church of Spitz, Lower Austria within 400 m, and Wachau within 1100 m.
